newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent drifts crude as U.S. gasoline stalls.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent drifts crude as U.S. gasoline stalls.

text.p: IPE Brent crude was languishing just above session lows on Friday afternoon as U.S. gasoline failed to lead the market into a reversal of early losses, brokers said.
"Brent was due a bit of consolidation after this week's gains and only gasoline could really lead us higher again," said a broker.
Oct Brent was 16 cents weaker at $18.90 a barrel by 1419 GMT, seven cents above the session low and struggling to move higher after breaking below trendline support at $18.95 earlier in the day.
